title: 看同伴慢慢示范
description: 一位成人在低墙演示短步，另一位在垫区外观察。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult demonstrates one easy low-wall step with both feet on large holds near the mat and hands on generous jugs. A second adult watches attentively from outside the landing boundary, never beneath the climber. Capture a calm pause after the step, allowing the body position and footholds to be read together. The wall is sparse, the reach modest, and an oversized step-down option remains immediately beside the climber. Use miniature ceramic-relief illustration with glazed-looking illustrated forms, low relief depth, and a restrained white, cobalt, and pale jade palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
